title: Michael Borck's World
subtitle: An interactive map of a career
summary: AI Leader and Cyber Security expert with 35+ years spanning military → academia → industry consulting. Author of the "Learning with AI" open-textbook series (Conversation, Not Delegation; The Human Edge; Speak Software; Model Data, Verify AI, plus domain companions), creator of innovative educational AI tools, and a leader in AI-enhanced pedagogy serving academics, education, agriculture and mining sectors. Founder of LocoLabo, a self-funded applied-AI research lab (12 projects, 52 GPUs, $0 sponsorship) mapping what small local models can do on hardware people already own, with a rare combination of technical depth and educational innovation expertise. Teaching philosophy grounded in three conceptual pillars - Caring, Competence, and Passion, with a core principle of "Make Contact Count."
